# I Need Barcode

> I Need Barcode (https://ineedbarcode.com/) is a free barcode and QR Code generator that runs in the browser. It needs no registration, adds no watermark, supports 100+ barcode formats, and exports print-ready PNG files. The site is available in 98 languages and was created by Abid Hanan Wicaksono.

## What it does

- Generates QR Code, Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, GS1 and 100+ other formats.
- Creates codes for text, URLs, Wi-Fi, contacts, email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, locations and events.
- Bulk mode generates up to 100 barcodes at once and downloads them as a ZIP of PNG files.
- Design options: colors, module size, rotation, shapes (circle, heart, star and more), dot styles, frames with text, transparent background.
- Barcode contents are processed in the visitor's browser and are not sent to a server.

## Frequently asked questions

- Is I Need Barcode free? Yes. You can create and download as many barcodes as you like, with no sign-up and no watermark.
- Which barcode type should I choose? Use QR Code for links, Wi-Fi, and contacts. Use EAN-13 or UPC-A for retail products, Code 128 for shipping and inventory, and Data Matrix for small labels.
- Can I use the barcodes commercially? Yes. The images you create are yours to use on products, packaging, and print. For EAN and UPC on retail products, register your numbers with GS1.
- Why does my barcode show an error? Each type has its own rules. For example, EAN-13 accepts only 12 or 13 digits. Read the error message and adjust your data.

## Guides (English)

- [What Is a Barcode? Definition, How It Works, and Types](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/apa-itu-barcode): Barcodes are on almost every product you buy. Learn how they work, their brief history, and the most commonly used types of barcodes.
- [What Is a QR Code and How Does It Work?](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/apa-itu-qr-code): A QR Code can store links, text, and even WiFi details, and it stays readable even when partly damaged. Here is how it works and what makes it useful.
- [How to Create a Free QR Code in 3 Steps](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/cara-membuat-qr-code-gratis): A practical guide to creating QR Codes for links, WiFi, contacts, or WhatsApp with no app and no sign-up, complete with tips to make them easy to scan.
- [1D vs 2D Barcodes: Which One Do You Need?](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/perbedaan-barcode-1d-dan-2d): Line barcodes and QR Codes are both barcodes, but they serve different purposes. Compare their capacity, how they are scanned, and examples of their use.
- [How to Get an EAN-13 Product Barcode for Small Businesses](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/cara-mendapatkan-barcode-ean-13): Want your products in convenience stores or supermarkets? Learn what the EAN-13 digits mean, how to register an official number with GS1 Indonesia, and how to print it.
- [How to Create a WiFi QR Code So Guests Don't Have to Type the Password](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/cara-membuat-qr-code-wifi): Guests just scan a QR Code to connect to WiFi. Ideal for cafés, offices, guesthouses, and homes. Here is how to create one and put it up.
- [The Right Barcode Size and Resolution for Printing](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/ukuran-barcode-untuk-dicetak): Barcodes that are too small or blurry are hard to scan. Learn the minimum sizes, the scanning distance rule, and safe image resolutions for printing.
- [7 Reasons a Barcode Won't Scan and How to Fix Them](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/barcode-tidak-bisa-dipindai): Is your barcode or QR Code failing to scan? Check the seven most common causes, from color contrast to size, along with how to fix them.
- [QR Codes for Restaurant Menus: A Complete Guide](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/qr-code-menu-restoran): A digital menu via QR Code makes things easier for customers and saves on printing costs. Here is how to create one, prepare the menu, and place it on tables.
- [Creative QR Code Designs That Can Still Be Scanned](https://ineedbarcode.com/en/artikel/desain-qr-code-kreatif): QR Codes can be shaped like a heart or a circle, or given frames and colors. Learn the rules for keeping the design attractive and easy to scan at the same time.
